# Picard Relay

> Small Node.js + SQLite relay for exact approved, bounded AI requests and durable saved results. The current live-provider contract is Groq openai/gpt-oss-20b, one call per grant, no tools/execution/retries/paid fallback. This is not an autonomous coding agent or general task board.

## Read first
- [Documentation index](docs/README.md): reading order and source-of-truth rules.
- [Quickstart](docs/QUICKSTART.md): what the relay does, offline demo, console workflow.
- [AI contributor instructions](AGENTS.md): source trees, checks and operating boundaries.
- [Structured project map](docs/project-map.json): capabilities, constraints, paths and entrypoints.
- [Structured work register](docs/work-register.json): known bugs and feature requests with dated states.

## Interpretation
Top-level src is the offline/preview tree. experimental/runtime-control/src is the complete signed-runtime source. Their roles differ; do not assume a root source edit updates an enrolled host. GitHub signs/publishes source; separately enrolled hosts install it. Completed means saved response, not correct/executed/deployed/accepted work. Free-policy enrollment is retained configuration evidence, not a current billing check. Uncertain invocations remain spent and must not be automatically replayed. Older checkpoint documents are historical; use the current index, actual source/tests and dated host evidence.
